fields.summary_ko.0: Intel (INTC) is ahead of Q3 earnings announcement, having declined over 20% in the past month while Micron (MU) down 10%, AMD (AMD) down 10%, and Nvidia (NVDA) down 3%, reflecting broad chip sector weakness
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 consensus EPS of $0.40 and revenue of $16.5 billion expected, representing substantial increase versus year-ago Q3 EPS of $0.23 and revenue of $13.6 billion
fields.summary_ko.2: With SK Hynix strong earnings announcement (revenue up 328%, operating profit up 632%) easing AI sector concerns, Intel foundry business revenue expected at $6.1 billion, up 44% year-over-year
